projects.name: EVENTO Project Development
projects.notes: Primary legal company platform. Verified Supabase backend: Evento project 1. Public web/PWA surface, client accounts and the request portal are implemented in EVENTo0/AAA-prompt-empire at apps/evento-web; contracts, typecheck and production build pass and the account journey is verified against a protocol stub. Not deployed, and the project_requests migration is source-controlled but deliberately unapplied because the Supabase project is shared with EVENTO Mobile. Keep this surface separate from the private mobile product repository and from the internal Control Plane.

projects.name: EVENTO Mobile
projects.notes: Private Flutter mobile product. RC6 Android development build has verified static analysis, tests, package identity, signing and APK artifact upload. GitHub Actions artifact `evento-dev-apk-rc6` is the authoritative phone-install handoff; device acceptance and production distribution remain separate gates. Product code and release evidence remain authoritative in EVENTo0/evento-mobile.
